candidates.title: Tax on $55,000 in Australia 2026-27: $6,845 Tax + $1,100 Medicare
candidates.description: Tax on $55,000 in 2026-27 is $6,845 income tax plus $1,100 Medicare levy: $7,945 in total (14.4% of salary), leaving $47,055 take-home a year.
